0.

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part III ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 28 August 1975, after the draft finalized by the Acoustics Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. 0.2 The object of this standard is to specify performance pressure unit operated horn loudspeakers as regards mechanical, climatic and acoustical properties. requirements of their electrical,

0.3 This standard (Part III ) shall be read in conjunction with IS : 7741 ( Part I )-1975" which covers the general requirements and methods of measurement. 0.4 Originally IS : 1032-1957 covered the pressure unit operated horn loudspeakers and is now being superseded by this standard. While preparing this standard the latest developments in testing methods and experience gained in the implementation of IS : 1032-1957 were taken into account. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-19607. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be tile same as that of the specified value in this star&rd.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard ( Part III ) specifies the performance requirements for pressure unit operated horn loudspeakers regarding its acollsticalz CIwtricaI, mechanical, and climatic properties.

IS: 7741( Part HI) - 1975 1.2 Unless otherwise `stated, the loudspeaker shall be understood to include both loudspeaker element and loudspeaker systems comprising one or more loudspeaker elements and such relevant devices as built-in cross-over filters, transformers and any other passive elements. 1.3 Dimensional requirements are not covered in the standard.

2. TERMINOLOGY 2.1 For the purpose of this standard, the terms and definitions specified in IS : 7741 (Part I )-1975' and IS : 1885 ( Part III/Set 2 )-1966t shall apply. 3. GENERAL CONDITIONS FOR TESTS shall apply.

3.1 Provisions of 3 of IS : 7741 ( Part I )-1975* 4. CATEGORY 4.1 Loudspeakers ( Part I )-1975*. 5. MARKING 5.1 Provisions of 5 of IS : 7741 ( Part I )-1975* 6. WORKMANSHIP AND FINISH shall belong to climatic
